surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Maryam (Mary) is the 19th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 98 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كٓهيعٓصٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ كهيعص
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم كهيعص
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Kaf Ha Ya 'Ayn Sad

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذكر رحمت ربك عبده زكريا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is an account of your Lord’s grace towards His servant, Zachariah

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ نادى ربه نداء خفيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When he called to his Lord a private supplication
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when he called to his Lord secretly, saying

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبࣰ ا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب اني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الراس شيبا ولم اكن بدعائك رب شقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Lord, my bones have weakened and my hair is ashen grey, but never, Lord, have I ever prayed to You in vain

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واني خفت الموالي من ورائي وكانت امراتي عاقرا فهب لي من لدنك وليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I fear [what] my kinsmen [will do] when I am gone, for my wife is barren, so grant me a successor––a gift from You––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يرثني ويرث من ال يعقوب ۖ واجعله رب رضيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him well pleasing [to You].’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا زَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا زكريا انا نبشرك بغلام اسمه يحيى لم نجعل له من قبل سميا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Zachariah, We bring you good news of a son whose name will be John––We have chosen this name for no one before him.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب انى يكون لي غلام وكانت امراتي عاقرا وقد بلغت من الكبر عتيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I am old and frail?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين وقد خلقتك من قبل ولم تك شيئا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘This is what your Lord has said: “It is easy for Me: I created you, though you were nothing before.” ’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالࣲ سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي آيَةً ۚ قَالَ آيَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب اجعل لي اية ۚ قال ايتك الا تكلم الناس ثلاث ليال سويا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Give me a sign, Lord.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to anyone for three full [days and] nights.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فخرج على قومه من المحراب فاوحى اليهم ان سبحوا بكرة وعشيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He went out of the sanctuary to his people and signalled to them to praise God morning and evening

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةࣲۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا يَحْيَىٰ خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة ۖ واتيناه الحكم صبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [We said], ‘John, hold on to the Scripture firmly.’ While he was still a boy, We granted him wisdom

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَحَنَانࣰ ا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةࣰۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَحَنَانًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَزَكَاةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وحنانا من لدنا وزكاة ۖ وكان تقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: tenderness from Us, and purity. He was devout

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وبرا بوالديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: kind to his parents, not domineering or rebellious

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وسلام عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he died, and it will be on him the day he is raised to life again

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانࣰ ا شَرۡقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر في الكتاب مريم اذ انتبذت من اهلها مكانا شرقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mention in the Quran the story of Mary. She withdrew from her family to a place to the east

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابࣰ ا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فارسلنا اليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and secluded herself away; We sent Our Spirit to appear before her in the form of a perfected man

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَتْ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالت اني اعوذ بالرحمن منك ان كنت تقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: She said, ‘I seek the Lord of Mercy’s protection against you: if you have any fear of Him [do not approach]!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمࣰ ا زَكِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال انما انا رسول ربك لاهب لك غلاما زكيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘I am but a Mes-senger from your Lord, [come] to announce to you the gift of a pure son.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرࣱ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالت انى يكون لي غلام ولم يمسسني بشر ولم اك بغيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me? I have not been unchaste,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ آيَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين ۖ ولنجعله اية للناس ورحمة منا ۚ وكان امرا مقضيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘This is what your Lord said: “It is easy for Me- We shall make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us.”’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانࣰ ا قَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ فحملته فانتبذت به مكانا قصيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And so it was ordained: she conceived him. She withdrew to a distant place

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيࣰ ا مَّنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَا لَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاجاءها المخاض الى جذع النخلة قالت يا ليتني مت قبل هذا وكنت نسيا منسيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and, when the pains of childbirth drove her to [cling to] the trunk of a palm tree, she exclaimed, ‘I wish I had been dead and forgotten long before all this!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فناداها من تحتها الا تحزني قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but a voice cried to her from below, ‘Do not worry: your Lord has provided a stream at your feet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبࣰ ا جَنِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وهزي اليك بجذع النخلة تساقط عليك رطبا جنيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and, if you shake the trunk of the palm tree towards you, it will deliver fresh ripe dates for you

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنࣰ اۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدࣰ ا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمࣰ ا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكلي واشربي وقري عينا ۖ فاما ترين من البشر احدا فقولي اني نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن اكلم اليوم انسيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so eat, drink, be glad, and say to anyone you may see: “I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy to abstain from conversation, and I will not talk to anyone today.”’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا فَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ ۖ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاتت به قومها تحمله ۖ قالوا يا مريم لقد جئت شيئا فريا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: She went back to her people carrying the child, and they said, ‘Mary! You have done something terrible

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءࣲ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا اخت هارون ما كان ابوك امرا سوء وما كانت امك بغيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man; your mother was not unchaste!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاشارت اليه ۖ قالوا كيف نكلم من كان في المهد صبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: She pointed at him. They said, ‘How can we converse with an infant?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال اني عبد الله اتاني الكتاب وجعلني نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [But] he said: ‘I am a servant of God. He has granted me the Scripture; made me a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجعلني مباركا اين ما كنت واوصاني بالصلاة والزكاة ما دمت حيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: made me blessed wherever I may be. He commanded me to pray, to give alms as long as I live

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارࣰ ا شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وبرا بوالدتي ولم يجعلني جبارا شقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to cherish my mother. He did not make me domineering or graceless

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: والسلام علي يوم ولدت ويوم اموت ويوم ابعث حيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Peace was on me the day I was born, and will be on me the day I die and the day I am raised to life again.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذلك عيسى ابن مريم ۚ قول الحق الذي فيه يمترون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدࣲۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَانَهُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما كان لله ان يتخذ من ولد ۖ سبحانه ۚ اذا قضى امرا فانما يقول له كن فيكون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه ۚ هذا صراط مستقيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاختلف الاحزاب من بينهم ۖ فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ الظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اسمع بهم وابصر يوم ياتوننا ۖ لكن الظالمون اليوم في ضلال مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانذرهم يوم الحسرة اذ قضي الامر وهم في غفلة وهم لا يؤمنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for they are heedless and do not believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا نحن نرث الارض ومن عليها والينا يرجعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر في الكتاب ابراهيم ۚ انه كان صديقا نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَا أَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيْئًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لابيه يا ابت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغني عنك شيئا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا ابت اني قد جاءني من العلم ما لم ياتك فاتبعني اهدك صراطا سويا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَانَ ۖ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا ابت لا تعبد الشيطان ۖ ان الشيطان كان للرحمن عصيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابࣱ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا ابت اني اخاف ان يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطان وليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنْتَ عَنْ آلِهَتِي يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ۖ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَاهْجُرْنِي مَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال اراغب انت عن الهتي يا ابراهيم ۖ لئن لم تنته لارجمنك ۖ واهجرني مليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال سلام عليك ۖ ساستغفر لك ربي ۖ انه كان بي حفيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدْعُو رَبِّي عَسَىٰ أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعَاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون الله وادعو ربي عسى الا اكون بدعاء ربي شقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلما اعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون الله وهبنا له اسحاق ويعقوب ۖ وكلا جعلنا نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصࣰ ا وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر في الكتاب موسى ۚ انه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وناديناه من جانب الطور الايمن وقربناه نجيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ووهبنا له من رحمتنا اخاه هارون نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر في الكتاب اسماعيل ۚ انه كان صادق الوعد وكان رسولا نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكان يامر اهله بالصلاة والزكاة وكان عند ربه مرضيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر في الكتاب ادريس ۚ انه كان صديقا نبيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ورفعناه مكانا عليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We raised him to a high station
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We raised him to a high position

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحࣲ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدࣰ اۤ وَبُكِيࣰّ ا۩
ayahs.arabic_simple: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ آدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْرَائِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
ayahs.arabic_clean: اولئك الذين انعم الله عليهم من النبيين من ذرية ادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذرية ابراهيم واسرائيل وممن هدينا واجتبينا ۚ اذا تتلى عليهم ايات الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا ۩
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ فخلف من بعدهم خلف اضاعوا الصلاة واتبعوا الشهوات ۖ فسوف يلقون غيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا من تاب وامن وعمل صالحا فاولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون شيئا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: جنات عدن التي وعد الرحمن عباده بالغيب ۚ انه كان وعده ماتيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا الا سلاما ۖ ولهم رزقهم فيها بكرة وعشيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: تلك الجنة التي نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما نتنزل الا بامر ربك ۖ له ما بين ايدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك ۚ وما كان ربك نسيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبادته ۚ هل تعلم له سميا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَإِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ويقول الانسان ااذا ما مت لسوف اخرج حيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: اولا يذكر الانسان انا خلقناه من قبل ولم يك شيئا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فوربك لنحشرنهم والشياطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة ايهم اشد على الرحمن عتيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم لنحن اعلم بالذين هم اولى بها صليا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان منكم الا واردها ۚ كان على ربك حتما مقضيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا ونذر الظالمين فيها جثيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرࣱ مَّقَامࣰ ا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذا تتلى عليهم اياتنا بينات قال الذين كفروا للذين امنوا اي الفريقين خير مقاما واحسن نديا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثࣰ ا وَرِءۡيࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِئْيًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم احسن اثاثا ورئيا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَانࣰ ا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل من كان في الضلالة فليمدد له الرحمن مدا ۚ حتى اذا راوا ما يوعدون اما العذاب واما الساعة فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا واضعف جندا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدࣰ ىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابࣰ ا وَخَيۡرࣱ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى ۗ وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدى ۗ والباقيات الصالحات خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالࣰ ا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: افرايت الذي كفر باياتنا وقال لاوتين مالا وولدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: اطلع الغيب ام اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا ۚ سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من العذاب مدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونرثه ما يقول وياتينا فردا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واتخذوا من دون الله الهة ليكونوا لهم عزا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا ۚ سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: الم تر انا ارسلنا الشياطين على الكافرين تؤزهم ازا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلا تعجل عليهم ۖ انما نعد لهم عدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم نحشر المتقين الى الرحمن وفدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونسوق المجرمين الى جهنم وردا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يملكون الشفاعة الا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لقد جئتم شيئا ادا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: You have done an atrocious thing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How terrible is this thing you assert

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: تكاد السماوات يتفطرن منه وتنشق الارض وتخر الجبال هدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان دعوا للرحمن ولدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما ينبغي للرحمن ان يتخذ ولدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا آتِي الرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان كل من في السماوات والارض الا اتي الرحمن عبدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لقد احصاهم وعدهم عدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكُلُّهُمْ آتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكلهم اتيه يوم القيامة فردا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمࣰ ا لُّدࣰّ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُدًّا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانما يسرناه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من احد او تسمع لهم ركزا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper
